direct_whole_operator.interpretation: Measured direct Kronecker Frobenius norms; actual adjoint used, no H averaging. Operator skew norm is bounded by its Frobenius norm. This is computed floating-point evidence, not an interval-certified error bound.

trajectory_norm_squared_drift_estimate.scope: Computed-skew a-posteriori whole-state-space estimate, excluding separate floating-point expm error; not a bound on omitted physical many-body action.

physical_orthogonality.formula: delta_core + sqrt(162)*(1+delta_core)*(product_9(1+delta_local)-1), using measured Frobenius defects as operator-norm upper estimates. Local-isometry error is NOT ignored when quoting core orthogonality.

span_departure_estimates.scope: Conservative telescoping/Wedin-style estimates for normalized physical Slater columns: neutral9*delta_local; charged(8sqrt6+1)*delta_local due repeated neutral labels, plus TT discard; divide by retained smallest physical state singular minus column residual. These are not interval-certified; tiny floating Slater normalization deviations are not separately measured. Actual selected-state cache departures1.44e-10/1.54e-10 are reported separately, NOT substituted for whole-span bounds.
span_departure_estimates.all_positive_global_directions_retained: 27 neutral and162 per charged block; smallest retained physical state singulars >=2.937e-5, far above numerical discard scale. No two-small-positive Gram-direction drop.

receivers_and_sources.meaning: One-sided physical TT/acted-CP source/receiver maps retain explicit~1e-10 numerical limits; no clipping, polar replacement or probability normalization repair. They are distinct from direct-H roundoff~1e-16 relative.

metric_definitions: Spin L1=sum absolute probability differences; TV=L1/2. Mean-Sz difference and momentum/density L2 norms are not TV.
